_about: Inventory of quantitative claims in the MAG parts of ~/Documents/prFBA_paper/prFBA.tex (sec:mag 161-179, sec:magreal 744-806, sec:magval 808-938, abstract L63/L72, discussion L1173-1174, limitations L1210, plus cross-referenced MAG claims inside sec:twopanel).
